title: Odd One Out
summary: Name what most items share, then spot the exception.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Look for a property most of the numbers share.
Then find the one that breaks it.
points: Look for a property most of the numbers share.

steps.title: The method: Find the shared property
sentences: 2, 3, 5 and 11 are all prime numbers, which can be divided only by 1 and themselves.
So 9 is the one that is not prime.
points: 2, 3, 5 and 11 are all prime numbers, which can be divided only by 1 and themselves.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: A good answer always includes a reason.
There may sometimes be more than one reason that works.

quiz.q: Which is the odd one out: 4, 9, 16, 20, 25?
quiz.why: Others are square numbers; 20 is not.
